certificate.description: Fortanix DSM Appliance is the ideal building block for implementing Fortanix DSM in a private cloud or as a managed service. With DSM, you can securely generate, store, and use cryptographic keys and certificates, as well as secrets, such as passwords, API keys, tokens, or any blob of data.
